caption: Figure 7: Summary of the common slow detection logic in all studied systems.
subject: the common two-staged warning/fatal threshold logic used across distributed systems to detect and escalate a slow metric

groups.why_chosen: All studied systems detect slowness the same two-staged way: a monitored metric first crosses a warning threshold, triggering a warning action, and only reaches a fatal action either by exceeding a separate, higher fatal threshold directly, or by accumulating enough warnings (the warning count) over time.
groups.what_to_learn: a two-threshold decision flowchart generalized from many concrete systems' logic, with a small reference table of real threshold values alongside it
